articles.title: Policy at Consensus Miami: State of Crypto
Agentic commerce will run on crypto rails, PayPal and Google reps tell Consensus Miami
articles.snippet: Senior figures from PayPal and Google Cloud said open payment protocols, machine-readable merchant catalogs and multi-party crypto custody are needed to scale agentic commerce.

articles.title: Trump Media’s Q1 loss widens to $406 million on bitcoin, CRO markdowns
articles.snippet: The loss was primarily driven by $244 million in unrealized losses on cryptocurrency holdings and an additional $108.2 million investment loss.

articles.title: It might be too late for bitcoin’s quantum migration, Project Eleven report argues
articles.snippet: Quantum computing does not only pose a risk to up to $3 trillion in digital assets, it also threatens the security of banking systems, military communications, digital identities and more, Project Eleven’s report warns.

articles.title: Crypto wallets are being rebuilt for AI agents, Trust Wallet and Mesh executives say at Consensus Miami
articles.snippet: Trust Wallet CEO Felix Fan and Mesh CTO Arjun Mukherjee said AI agents are creating a new role for crypto wallets.
